name: BSP_Gun_Fire
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Ghidra has no function here; FUN_0072F830's body stops at 0073015C, so the body was read from the raw listing with capstone. Picks a barrel through 007298D0, writes throwA/throwB to gun+400h/+404h, spawns through 0072F830, calls 0072D520 at 007309E8, advances nextFireBarrel at 007309ED and reloads barrelDelayTime at 00730A05. The three-argument shape is proved from the caller 008BE440, whose SEH slot sits at ESP+514h both at 008BE54B and at 008BE5BE across a call made with ESP twelve bytes lower. docs/UNIT_WEAPON_DEVICES.md. | Packet cc7_gun_dispersion: steps 7 and 8, previously 'contract: unread'. RET 0Ch at 00730A1B, body 00730160-00730A1D, __thiscall(gun, int useExplicitThrow, float throwA, float throwB). Frame A = entry-108h, so the arguments are [ESP+10Ch]/[ESP+110h]/[ESP+114h]. The throw magnitude is gun[+3F8h]+4h, the Lua Throw from 007313E0; zeroed when gunclass[+80h] is 1, 5 or 6 and GameSettings+760h (TurnOffAAGunThrow) is set; then multiplied at 00730498 by vtable[24h]() on one of six seat pointers gun+390h..+3A4h selected by bullet sub-type and gated by 00521E70(unit, role) with role = (offset-390h)/4+2. Sub-type 0Ah takes the deterministic torpedo fan Throw*barrel/(n-1) - Throw/2 instead. Otherwise gun+400h = U(0,2pi) and gun+404h = tan(Throw)*U(0,1), both from RNG stream 1 at 00730557 and 00730575; gun+404h is additionally scaled by unit+63Ch for sub-types 4..7 and both by 00470440(7, unit). The direction becomes matrix row2 + gun+404h*(cos*row1 + sin*row0) of gun[+3CCh]+0F0h, unnormalised. docs/GUN_DISPERSION.md | Packet cc7_gun_mount_positions: the mount tail 00730762..00730A0E, which docs/GUN_DISPERSION.md left as 'call shape only'. Per shot, with frame A = entry-108h: count = (class+0A0h - class+9Ch)/0Ch (00730762-00730793); 004181A0(class+98h, gun+44Ch) returns the 0Ch-byte local mount point (007307A0); 004142E0 transforms it by the mount node's world matrix into the world muzzle point (007307D3); the two become arguments 1 and 2 of 0072F830, argument 3 being the direction from row 2 of the same matrix. gun+44Ch then advances (i+1) % gun+448h at 007309ED..00730A0E. A null begin pointer or a non-positive count routes to the fallback at 00730875, which re-reads gun+3BCh - the model's own first node, NOT gun+3CCh - refreshes it through 00B6DB70 and fires from its translation at node+120h with a zeroed local offset. The node matrix is copied from gun[+3CCh]+0F0h at 007301D1 and may first be pre-multiplied by a matrix [gun+3Ch]'s vtable slot 94h supplies when slot 8Ch answers true (00730217/0073021B/00730225); those slots are unread. docs/GUN_MOUNT_POSITIONS.md.
